outcome: accuracy of prenatal ultrasound in identifying cyst aetiology
cohort: 137 foetuses diagnosed with intra-abdominal cysts (excluding those from the urinary system) during the prenatal period between April 2015 and August 2018.
finding: The accuracy of prenatal ultrasound in identifying the origin of fetal intra-abdominal cysts was high, and the perinatal outcome for these fetuses was generally favorable, though the clinical courses could be variable.
